why: the club places its restaurant terrace facing the sea toward the Karlsoarna, and the 0.16 m 2026 orthophoto shows a deck along this building's sea front and nothing of the kind on any other footprint here
the club's 13-hole putting course omsluter klubbhuset and runs from the old clubhouse toward the 18th green; this building stands 106 m from the 18th green and 25 m from the shore
the proshop, reception, restaurant and bar are all inside the clubhouse per the club opening hours, which makes it one large building, and this is the largest on the hub
clubhouseEvidence.notChosen: way/530655628 is larger at 924 m2 but stands 800 m north-east among the works buildings, under the dark industrial roofs the orthophoto shows
clubhouseEvidence.status: reviewed identification, not a club-declared reference
